corrections.why: byte re-read by a non-drafting agent: All access claims hold (cmp [rcx+0xF0],0 -> return 0; ten vtable +0x50 calls with edx 0..9 and cmovs keep; re-test of [rdi+0xF0]; rcx = qword [01F3BA68] (rip target of 00786168), rdx = ptr-8; zero store; return ebx). But "frees" states the callee purpose, which this body does not show: 006DA8A0 is a 13-byte thunk that decrements dword 02EA0B3C and tail-jumps through vtable slot +0x10 of its rcx object. Reworded to the call itself.

byte re-read by a non-drafting agent: Bytes hold the shape, but "while byte is set" reads as a loop (it is a single cmp/je per byte), "else keeps the byte 1" is wrong in kind (the body stores 1 at 007DA9A9 / 007DA9D8 whatever nonzero value it held), the sum is stored to the float before the comparison, and "float ramps" is an interpretation. comiss/jb: the clamp path runs when the sum is not below the limit; jb (also taken on unordered) stores 1. Each +0x40 call sits inside its byte branch.
